newsitem.title: UK: BAA higher on sharp airport traffic rise.
newsitem.headline: BAA higher on sharp airport traffic rise.

text.p: Shares in British airports operators BAA Plc opened higher on Thursday after the company said traffic at its seven UK airports had risen over nine percent in November, compared to last year.
The shares were up 7-1/2p at 490p by 0830 GMT.
BAA said the rise was the largest monthly increase since March bringing total November passengers to 7.1 million and an underlying growth of 8.3 percent.
It is estimated that the channel tunnel closure, caused by a fire, boosted November airport traffic by 50,000 passengers.
